answer: One concrete mechanism: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because sonnet only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice timber is enforced by the ledger itself: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any opal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
